import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import zipfile

with open\('E:/download/training_scheme_test.docx', 'rb'\) as f:
    with zipfile.ZipFile\(f, 'r'\) as zf:
        content = zf.read\('word/document.xml'\).decode\('utf-8'\)

ns = {'w': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'}
tree = ET.fromstring\(content\)
tables = tree.findall\('.//w:tbl', ns\)

print\(f'Found {len\(tables\)} tables'\)

for i, table in enumerate\(tables\):
    print\(f'\\\\n=== Table {i+1} ==='\)
    rows = table.findall\('.//w:tr', ns\)
    
    for r_idx, row in enumerate\(rows[:5]\):  # First 5 rows
        cells = row.findall\('.//w:tc', ns\)
        cell_texts = []
        for cell in cells:
            texts = cell.findall\('.//w:t', ns\)
            text = ''.join\(t.text or '' for t in texts\)
            if text:
                cell_texts.append\(text\)
        if cell_texts:
            print\(f'Row {r_idx+1}: {cell_texts}'\)
")
